sloka: धनुर् आदाय सशरम् खनित्र पिटका धरः ।अग्रतः ते गमिष्यामि पन्थानम् अनुदर्शयन् ॥२-३१-२३॥
transliteration: dhanur ādāya saśaram khanitra piṭakā dharaḥ ।agrataḥ te gamiṣyāmi panthānam anudarśayan ॥2-31-23॥

translations.english: Holding the bow and arrows and carrying a crowbar and a basket, I shall go in front of you leading the way.
